newsitem.title: UK: Pizza Express falls on newspaper report.
newsitem.headline: Pizza Express falls on newspaper report.

text.p: Shares in Pizza Express Plc fell on Monday after a report in the Sunday Times newspaper highlighted recent selling of the stock by directors of the restaurant operator, dealers said.
Pizza Express shares dropped 6p to 634p by 0840 GMT in thin volume of 24,000 shares.

The report said three Pizza Express directors, including chairman Luke Johnson, had sold over one million shares between them since April this year, which could encourage other investors to offload the stock.
The shares have underperformed the pubs and brewing sector by nearly four percent since April and the newspaper said investors were cautious on the restaurant chain's plans to expand overseas.
"Wrestling with overseas markets in the pub and restaurant business is always a risk," said one analyst.
